en.title: 3D: models made in code that move
en.body: `createSdfRig3D(shape, bones, options)` skins a distance-field model to bones at its joints. Each bone names where it turns, its parent and the parts it moves, and pairs come from one side with `mirror: 'x'`; every vertex follows the up to four bones whose parts are nearest, so joints bend instead of tearing. `rig.clip(name, duration, poses)` turns poses of named bones (Euler angles and offsets at times) into a clip, `rig.play` fades between clips and `rig.update` moves them on. The library's villager walks and the fox trots, and the gallery shows them moving.

zh.title: 3D：用代码做的模型可以动了
zh.body: `createSdfRig3D(shape, bones, options)` 把距离场模型蒙皮到关节处的骨骼上。每根骨骼写明转动点、父骨骼和它带动的零件，成对的骨骼用 `mirror: 'x'` 由一侧生成；每个顶点跟随零件离它最近的至多四根骨骼，所以关节是弯曲而不是撕开。`rig.clip(name, duration, poses)` 把命名骨骼的姿势（各时间点的欧拉角和偏移）变成动画片段，`rig.play` 在片段之间淡入淡出，`rig.update` 推进动画。范例库的村民会走路、狐狸会小跑，画廊里能看到它们在动。
